details.description: Broad cream upper shell with inward lower notch and symmetric handle shoulders.
Two long rounded grips descend and flare toward the palm ends.
Continuous front-to-rear perimeter shell seam.
Diagonal curved cream-to-pink boundary across each grip.
Raised rounded cross D-pad with broad arm fillets.
Four round unlabeled face buttons arranged in a diamond.
Left analog stick rises from a cream socket ring with a recessed cap centre.
Right analog stick mirrors the left with its own socket ring and cap recess.
Small rose status/home lens centred above the select button.
Small horizontal rounded select button below the status lens.
Left and right upper bumpers sit proud of the shoulder deck.
Second pink trigger layer is visible behind and below each bumper.
Rounded rectangular rear battery/service cover centred on the back shell.
Four countersunk circular screw heads repeat across the rear lower shell and grip ends.
Pink rounded rear upper-centre inset interrupts the cream shoulder deck.
Cream analog socket rings carry a narrow catch-light bevel around each pink stick.
Pink button crowns and grip panels have slightly glossier highlights than the cream shell.
Thin dark cavity lines separate buttons, grip panels, battery cover and shell halves.
Stable dark-plum outline hierarchy uses main, structure and detail widths with object-space plus/minus 18 percent variation.
Broad planar shell facets step around the shoulder deck and waist without adding a raised panel.
A controlled plum undercut separates each bumper from its trigger through the full press arc.
Each faceted analog cap keeps a clearly recessed thumb dish and readable crown rim.

Anticipation, heartbeat, frenzy, ultimate, ready finale, settle and stop retain one animation owner and exact reset.

visualAcceptance.scoringRule: AI vision must inspect a side-by-side reference/render sheet and score the current pass from 0 to 1. Pixel-diff code may assist diagnostics but cannot approve a pass.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: Choose only the most visually salient, identity-defining, user-prioritized, or high-risk semantic systems. Group repeated parts instead of reviewing every mesh. AI vision scores every selected feature from the same full reference/render pair.

screenshotPolicy.minimumEvidence: Each visual pass needs a reference image, rendered screenshot, side-by-side comparison sheet, AI vision score, layer scores, and critique before choosing continue.
screenshotPolicy.reviewPairRule: Compare the same camera/viewpoint whenever possible; do not judge a front reference against a random render angle.
screenshotPolicy.acceptanceAuthority: AI vision review of the comparison sheet. Code-generated pixel similarity is not sufficient evidence.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Hidden PCB, rumble motors, stick gimbals, membranes, trigger springs and battery contacts are omitted.
Rear upper-centre inset exterior is observed but its connector function and cavity depth are inferred.
Battery latch and exact screw drive pattern are not resolved.
